description: This PHP class, GenericDateDisplayFieldWithAggregate, extends the GenericDateDisplayField class and is part of a reporting module in the OrangeHRM system. It manages display fields with date and aggregation functionalities, likely used for reporting with grouped or aggregated date data.

classes.name: GenericDateDisplayFieldWithAggregate
classes.description: A class for handling date display fields with aggregate functions in reports, extending functionalities of the parent date display field class.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Sets entity alias, field, and aggregation method based on the display field's alias.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object used for this display field.

methods.name: getAggregate
methods.description: Retrieves the aggregation function applied to the date field.

methods.name: setAggregate
methods.description: Sets the aggregation function for the date field.

methods.name: getSelectPart
methods.description: Constructs and returns the SQL select part for this display field with aggregation.
